problem.title: Free Fall Motion
problem.description: A problem about objects falling under gravity
problem.statement: A ball is dropped from a height of 100 meters. Assuming no air resistance and g=9.8 m/s², calculate the time it takes to hit the ground.
problem.essentialConcepts: Free fall motion, gravitational acceleration, kinematic equations
problem.conceptsConnection: Free fall is a special case of uniformly accelerated motion where the only force is gravity
problem.assumptions: No air resistance, constant gravitational acceleration
problem.commonMistakes: Forgetting square root, confusing velocity and acceleration
problem.additionalInformation: The equation s = ut + (1/2)gt² is fundamental
problem.instructorPlan: Start with basic kinematic equations, explain free fall as special case

studentMessage: I think I need to use the kinematic equation. What values do I have?
